usage: cli.py tune [-h] [--cfg CFG] [--prices PRICES] [--explain [EXPLAIN]]
                   [--explain-dir EXPLAIN_DIR] --out OUT [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cfg CFG             Path to regime config
  --prices PRICES       Optional prices CSV for replay summary
  --explain [EXPLAIN]   Write tuning explain JSON to path (or '-' for stdout).
  --explain-dir EXPLAIN_DIR
                        Write per-scenario explain JSON files to DIR.
  --out OUT             Output CSV path for tuning results
  --no-clobber          Fail if output file already exists.
